title: Gasket 64
subtitle: The first design: seven frames around one switch plate
summary: The earliest keyboard files, from May 2021: a 64-key case of seven stacked frames, where the switch plate has ears that sit in a slot between the frames and is not screwed to them.

sections.heading: A plate held by its ears
sections.body: The switch plate is wider than the opening in the frames. Its ears reach into a slot in the middle frames; the frame below carries them and the frame above leaves 1 mm clear. A later version of the file uses five frames in place of seven.
